propositions: A failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) in dispatch_one.py:324-328 triggers delete_issue, destroying a successfully-created Jira issue to recover from a labeling failure

The write-ahead binding recorded at dispatch_one.py:307-308 survives the issue deletion, leaving a keyed-pending entry pointing at a deleted key that strands the local ticket permanently on each subsequent recover_pending pass

The current rollback delete is redundant with recover_pending's KEYED branch, which already implements deterministic retro-attach without search, making the deletion destructive rather than protective

Jira rejects field writes with misleading 'Field cannot be set. It is not on the appropriate screen' errors in three cases: field missing from Create/Edit screen, jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property set, or malformed field value
The fix removes delete_issue, retitles BRIDGE_ALERT to indicate retention for retro-attach, re-raises write_err unmasked, and leaves the binding keyed-pending for recovery on the next pass
